apihelp-wikispeech-segment-summary: U kala qaybi nuxurka HTML ee bogga qaybo.
apihelp-wikispeech-segment-param-removet:
Calaamadaha HTML ee ay tahay in gebi ahaanba laga saaro inta lagu jiro nadiifinta, sida shay JSON ah oo qaabkan ah: 
{
	"tag1": true,
	"tag2": "css-class",
	"tag3": ["css-class-1", "css-class-2"]
}
halka tag1 mar walba laga saarayo, tag2 laga saarayo oo keliya haddii uu sidoo kale leeyahay fasalka CSS ee css-class, halka tag3 laga saarayo oo keliya haddii uu sidoo kale leeyahay mid ka mid ah fasallada CSS ee css-class-1 ama css-class-2. Ogow in wikispeech-listen uu isticmaalo qaabeynta caadiga ah marka uu kala qaybinayo, sidaas darteed waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan la jaanqaadi karin qaybaha lagu soo saaray dejin gaar ah oo aan caadi ahayn oo xulashadan ah.
apihelp-wikispeech-segment-param-segment: Calaamadaha HTML ee ay tahay inay kala jebiyaan qaybaha. Ogow in wikispeech-listen uu isticmaalo qaabeynta caadiga ah marka uu kala qaybinayo, sidaas darteed waxaa laga yaabaa inuusan la jaanqaadi karin qaybaha lagu soo saaray dejin gaar ah oo aan caadi ahayn xuduudaha.
apihelp-wikispeech-segment-param-part-of: Ku dar nuxur dheeraad ah oo loogu talagalay walxaha qaarkood.
apihelp-wikispeech-segment-param-consume: URL-ka waddada qoraalka ee wikiga macaamilka.

apihelp-wikispeech-segment-example-2: Kala qaybi adigoo isticmaalaya xuduudo gaar ah. Calaamadda sup waa laga saarayaa, sidoo kalena div marka uu leeyahay fasalka toc. Calaamadaha h1 iyo h2 waxay kala jebinayaan qaybaha.
apihelp-wikispeech-segment-example-3: Kala qaybi bogga hore ee wiki kale.
apierror-wikispeech-segment-removetagsin: <var>removetags</var> ma aha xadhig JSON oo ansax ah.
removetags ma aha qaab ansax ah. Waa inuu noqdaa shay ay qiimayaashiisu yihiin booleaanno, xadhko ama hannaan xadhko ah. Si aan wax calaamado ah loo saarin, removetags u dhig shay madhan, {}.
